limits: Structural/evidence-presence checks plus the round's own read-only commands (--check/--selftest/battery/replay). The runner does not re-run the ledger commands itself; the F leg cross-checks the recheck seats' receipts against the ledger's recorded hashes and the audit's independent re-runs.

The D e2e leg prefers a machine-readable receipt and re-runs its recorded command; when the output is not JSON the expected-vs-observed equality is read from the receipt's own lists, so a receipt that fabricates both lists is caught only by the output-hash pin (when declared) and the expected-token presence checks. Receipt shapes outside the documented keys are misses, not skips.

The sound-channel check is concrete: no PHON-INVENTORY line may name a GAR label or the word 'translated'. A different smuggling route (e.g. an owed form silently dropped) is covered only through the exact expected-set equality.

The battery is run with the committed baseline roots (frozen, expected, reports/round-9/baselines) plus any round-11 root carrying a gate-shaped <root>/<gate-stem>/expected.json; the plain default-root run leaves two gates uncovered (myth/naming) and is not used as the acceptance reading. Non-gate expected.json files (e.g. the handoff exercise's own baseline) are never fed to the battery.
The replay leg runs replay-frozen.py with a disposable TMPDIR outside the repo (the tool refuses an in-repo mirror by design), falling back to /tmp when the caller's TMPDIR sits under .scratch.
The exercise leg parses 16/16 and 20/20 from the exercise's own output (INFO scan line or JSON); a tool that hides its counts fails this leg even if its packet is correct.
'Committed' expected.json baseline is checked as an existing, parseable file read by the exercise; git-trackedness is recorded, not required — workers never commit.

The F 1:1 binding uses the receipt's index against the 192-row round-10 ledger; a receipt for a row whose ledger hash it cannot reproduce is rejected regardless of its own claims. Rows with no byte-comparable re-run (prose-only ledger rows, new_hash null) are bucketed as dispositioned unreproducible: excluded from the >=95% stability ratio and from the >=15 re-run count, but still required to carry a named cause.

Unstable-row causes are read from drift_class/drift_cause or inferred from the cause text; the licensed vocabulary is legitimate change / environmental / defect plus the unreproducible-by-construction class for prose-only ledger rows.

Calibration controls (disposable, untracked, 2026-10-17): .scratch/x03/make-fixture.py builds a hardlink/tar fixture whose synthetic round-11 evidence passes all three claims (exit 0), and .scratch/x03/controls.py plants 15 defects — an extra expected hold, a dropped owed form, a translated GAR label on the sound channel, a non-zero e2e exit, a missing re-pinned manifest, a stale typed projection, a 15/16 field count, an abandoned malformed control, an unshown gate reference, an absent baseline, a tampered ledger binding, undispositioned drift below the stability floor, an inflated summary count, a missing auditor artifact and a non-1:1 command — each was caught with exit 1 and the expected failure text. Scratch is not a deliverable and is not required for this runner to work.
Author-side only: no admission, promotion or canon decision; this runner replaces no independent review.
